end.summary:
Harsh practised reading and plotting ordered pairs; this was right in some examples but is not steady yet.
Harsh showed identifying quadrants from coordinate signs, including why points with a zero coordinate lie on an axis.
Harsh practised placing points on axes and reflecting across an axis; this was right in some examples but is not steady yet.
Harsh mixed up reversed ordered pairs: they corrected one example, but later treated (0,3) and (3,0) as the same, so this needs checking next time.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised ordered pairs, quadrants, axes, and reflection with Harsh. Harsh used the signs of x and y to identify quadrants and correctly noted that a zero coordinate places a point on an axis. They mixed up reversed ordered pairs again after correcting an earlier example, so at home please ask them to compare pairs such as (3,2) and (2,3), then plot both; this still needs checking next time.
